definitions.explanation: a ticket with a number used to manage order in a queue, commonly used at buses, popular shops, government offices, and events

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}ったら→乗る：00511_noru⟧{整理券|せいりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take a numbered ticket when you board the bus.

examples.japanese: {整理券|せいりけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧8⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Numbered tickets will be distributed starting at 8 a.m.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{整理券|せいりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got a numbered ticket at the popular ramen shop.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧ (organizing) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- Buses (uniform fare systems): Take when boarding, show when paying
- Popular restaurants: Distributed to manage wait times
- Government offices: Call numbers for service order
- Events/sales: Limit crowds and ensure fairness
- Hospitals: Patient order management

BUS USAGE:
On many Japanese buses, you take an {整理券|せいりけん} when boarding. When exiting, you pay based on the fare displayed for your ticket number.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {整理券|せいりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a numbered ticket)
- {整理券|せいりけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to distribute numbered tickets)
- {整理券|せいりけん}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ (ticket number)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{番号札|ばんごうふだ}→番号札：23504_bangoufuda⟧ (number tag)
- ⟦{順番待|じゅんばんま}ち→順番待ち：09747_junbanmachi⟧ (waiting in line)
- ⟦{呼|よ}び{出|だ}し→呼び出す：04813_yobidasu⟧ (being called)
